The portfolio was compiled and the compiler rejected it, as required, because one explicit request is outside the registered capability set.

| Experiment | Method | Samples | Replicates | Wells/notes | Release |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gfp-expression | gfp | 1 (positive template + its NTC → 2 reactions) | 1 | 50 µL reaction (45 µL cellfreeMIX + 5 µL DNA/water), 30 °C, 3 h | 0 s |
| bca-protein-quantification | bca | 2 unknowns | 2 | unknowns only counted; method adds 9 standards, all in duplicate | 0 s |
| picogreen-dna-quantification | picogreen | 3 unknowns | 1 (single well) | unknowns only counted; method adds 4 standards, single well each | 0 s |

- Deadline: 15:00 Asia/Shanghai = **21 600 s** from the 09:00 start (t=0).
- Budget: **CNY 570** (planned operating budget, preserved as given).
- Enabled instances only: device:19 (Fluent 1080), device:18 (Fluent 780), device:67 (SpectraMax iD5), demo:ks4000:1 (KS 4000 incubator), bench.
- Accepted assumptions: estimated costs, handling durations, digital carriers, layout assumptions.
- Manual preparation retained for cellfreeMIX, standards and working reagents; manual transport allowed; automated liquid-workstation assembly kept automated (no manual substitution of assembly).
- All registered assay conditions and controls (GFP NTC, BCA and PicoGreen standard curves) were kept.

**Rejection reason:** `UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST` — "Replace the registered assays with PCR amplification." PCR amplification is not a registered method (only gfp, bca, picogreen are source-bound and cannot be changed), so it was recorded verbatim in `unsupported_requests` and the graph was rejected rather than silently substituted.

Nothing was booked, no hardware was validated, and no measurements were produced. If you want to proceed, re-submit with the registered assays only (GFP expression, BCA, PicoGreen) — the rest of the portfolio above is ready to compile.
